about: Package 1's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/10-controls.mjs), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: The prompt card (package 4) is not drawn yet, so the Sampler stands 142px higher than on the concept's page and its solver list opens below its button, where the window cuts it by 15px: the list's edge fade (package 1's) says so. On the concept's page it opens above, whole. (The list's width now matches: the Sampler's scope is drawn, package 3a.)

The periodic table's shot: its rows stand a pixel lower, a sub-pixel offset of the header (no computed style, attribute or word differs inside the list; both shots are in tools/visual-baseline/out/*-controls/shots).

Deviation 10: an option's hook names its value (data-opt, data-v: "heun"), the concept's its label ("Heun"); data-setq, data-setn and data-base are the concept's delegated click hooks (a choice row's buttons run their own action here).
Deviation 11 (slice-accepted.json): every button and input carries its type.

Every choice row's buttons say what each sets in one form, "Temperature: 0.40" (the core's row.sets, as the Sampler's Quick rows say "Steps: 8"); the concept's How adventurous wrote its own "Temperature 0.4".

With the planner off the concept stands its tile's planner-only parts back (25-module-planner.js lm-off, a class on the Planner's tile): the Planner tile's own state, which its package builds; the row itself is the same.
A token takes the type of the row it stands in; the concept's Build foot is Build's own row (14px), here the shared tile foot (13px), the Build module's package's to match.
